expressroute-gateway-not-zone-redundant.title: Use a zone-redundant ExpressRoute gateway
expressroute-gateway-not-zone-redundant.body: The customer said this is a production workload, but this ExpressRoute gateway is not zone-redundant. Microsoft recommends zone-redundant gateways (ErGw1AZ, ErGw2AZ, ErGw3AZ or the scalable gateway) for resiliency across availability zones.

citation.source: Well-Architected Framework service guide for Azure ExpressRoute
citation.quote: Deploy ExpressRoute virtual network gateways that are zone-redundant for maximum resiliency and redundancy across Availability Zones.

expressroute-single-circuit-production.title: A single ExpressRoute circuit is not maximum resiliency
expressroute-single-circuit-production.body: The customer said this is a production workload, but the estimate has one circuit. Microsoft recommends multiple circuits at different peering locations for maximum resiliency; price a second circuit if the customer wants that.

citation.source: Well-Architected Framework service guide for Azure ExpressRoute
citation.quote: For Maximum Resiliency, configure multiple circuits to different peering locations

expressroute-delete-unused-circuits.title: Circuits bill from the moment they are created
expressroute-delete-unused-circuits.body: ExpressRoute circuits are charged from creation, even before the provider connects them. Delete circuits you no longer use, and deprovision them with the provider first.

citation.source: Well-Architected Framework service guide for Azure ExpressRoute
citation.quote: ExpressRoute circuits are charged from the moment they're created. To reduce unnecessary cost, deprovision the circuit with the service provider and delete the ExpressRoute circuit from your subscription.
